title: Abarinda Isarura ry'Ibanga
intro: Mu gihugu cy’ibimera bitoshye, itsinda ry’abantu ryakoze umugambi w’ibanga mu mwijima. Bari bahuriye ku ntego imwe, ariko umugambi wabo ntiwari ukwiye na gato. Ntibari bazi ko hari ikintu cy’Imana cyari kibategereje ubwo bari basinziriye.
clues: Twafashe icyemezo gikomeye, twibwira ko gahunda yacu nta makemwa.
Twari dufite intego yo gusohoka kare, mbere yuko abandi batangira kwivanga.
Twatangiye umugambi mwiza, twizeye ibyo dukenera.
Ubwo twageraga aho twajyaga, twasanze ari ubutayu kandi ari umusaka, bityo twibwiraga ko twari twayobye inzira.
Hanyuma twabonye ko ari twe koko, maze turarira cyane twihebye, twishinjanya ku byo twatakaje.
Muri icyo gitondo twari twararahiye ko tuzakuraho abakene mu musaruro wacu, ariko igihano cya Allah cyatugezeho turyamye, gihindura ubusitani bwacu amatongo.

trial.label: Igeragezwa ryacu
options: Ubusitani bwacu bwasenyutse kubera ibyago byaturutse mu ijuru
Ubusitani bwacu bwatwitswe n'umuriro uturutse ku mwanzi
trial.answer: Ubusitani bwacu bwasenyutse kubera ibyago byaturutse mu ijuru

location.label: Ikintu cy'ingenzi
options: Twarahiye ko tuzasarura imbuto zacyo mu gitondo
Twubatse urugomero rwo kuhira ubusitani bwacu
Twashatse ubuhungiro mu buvumo kugira ngo turindwe
Twafashe ubwato kugira ngo twambuke inyanja
location.answer: Twarahiye ko tuzasarura imbuto zacyo mu gitondo

outcome.label: Iherezo ryacu
options: Twihannye kandi twiringiye imbabazi zituruka kuri Allah
outcome.answer: Twihannye kandi twiringiye imbabazi zituruka kuri Allah

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
